title: Uptime & incidents
description: Uptime % per component and store (24 h / 7 d / 30 d), a downtime timeline, alert conditions over time, failures by kind, reconnects, print failures and error rates.

list.name: store
list.label: Store
list.description: Store slug (tenant) from the Pis' and hubs' resource labels.

panels.title: Uptime over the selected range (worst store)
main
panels.description: Share of the range main was reporting (absent counts as down). Under 99.9 %: look at the timeline below for when.

panels.title: Pi
panels.description: Worst store's share of the range its Pi was reporting (absent = down). Low: power or network at that store.

targets.expr: min(clamp_max(count_over_time((max by (tenant) ({__name__=~"agent_info(_ratio)?|agent_disk_free(_bytes)?", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}))[$__range:1m]) / (floor((time() - min_over_time(timestamp(max by (tenant) ({__name__=~"agent_info(_ratio)?|agent_disk_free(_bytes)?", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}))[$__range:1m])) / 60) + 1), 1))

panels.title: Pi to main link
panels.description: Worst store's share of reported time the Pi's SSE link to main was up. Low: the store's internet drops.

targets.expr: min(avg_over_time(((max by (tenant) ({__name__=~"sse_connected(_ratio)?", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}) or (max by (tenant) (sse_clients_active{deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|", service_name="quicc-main"}) > bool 0)))[$__range:1m]))

panels.title: Printers
panels.description: Worst store's share of reported time all its printers were up. Low: a printer keeps dropping; check its cable and power.

panels.title: Tablets
panels.description: Worst store's share of reported time at least one tablet was connected (closed hours count too). Low during open hours: tablet Wi-Fi or sleep.

panels.title: POS link
panels.description: Worst store's share of reported time the hub's status reached the Pi. Low: the hub box or its network is unstable.

panels.title: SoftTouch
panels.description: Worst store's share of reported time the hub could query SoftTouch. Low: the POS server or its LAN is unstable.

panels.title: SSE reconnects
panels.description: Times the Pis reconnected to main over the range. A few per day is normal; dozens mean the link is unstable.

panels.title: Uptime per store: 24 h / 7 d / 30 d
Uptime by component
panels.description: Per store and component: share of 24 h, 7 d and 30 d it was up. main and Pi count absence as down; the others count only time the Pi reported. Red under 99 %.

panels.title: Up / down by component
panels.description: Each component's state over the range. Red stretches are downtime; frequent short flips mean a loose cable or a weak link.

(max by (tenant) ({__name__=~"sse_connected(_ratio)?", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}) or (max by (tenant) (sse_clients_active{deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|", service_name="quicc-main"}) > bool 0))

panels.title: Alert conditions over time
panels.description: When each alert rule's condition was true, per store (recomputed from the rules' queries). A row appears only if it happened in the range; read it with the error logs.

targets.legendFormat: {{tenant}} order not acked by the Pi
{{tenant}} order sent with no Pi listening

panels.title: Alert rules firing now
panels.description: Grafana alert rules firing or pending for this env (each also pages Pushover). Empty means nothing is stuck right now.

panels.title: Failures by kind
panels.description: Every failure counter per interval across modules. Any bar is a delayed or lost order or command at that hop; hover to see which.

panels.title: Error log lines by service
panels.description: Error, fatal and panic log lines per interval by service (Pi and hub lines filtered to the stores). A spike lines up with the incident above it.

panels.title: SSE reconnects per hour
panels.description: How often each Pi reconnected to main. A steady stream means that store's internet or main is unstable.

panels.title: Print failures
panels.description: Print attempts where some ticket printed nowhere, by store and reason. Any bar is a ticket the kitchen may not have.

panels.title: Unaccepted-order pages
panels.description: Escalations the Pi sent because an order rang 2+ minutes unaccepted. Regular bars: the counter is not staffed when orders come in.

panels.title: Hub writes by outcome
panels.description: SoftTouch writes by kind, mode and result. Errors in live mode mean POS data is not being updated; shadow-mode rows are dry runs.

panels.title: Hub checks pulled
panels.description: SoftTouch checks the hub saw, by result (pulled, skipped, withdrawn). Pulled dropping to 0 in open hours means the POS feed stopped.
